rca_of_issue: Data Persistence Bug RCA: The original issue was that daily data (lordo, contanti, pos, etc.) did not persist when navigating between tabs. Root cause: The home screen was not reloading saved data from the store when the tab regained focus. Fix implemented: (1) Added useFocusEffect hook from expo-router that calls loadSavedData when the Home tab comes into focus, (2) Extracted loadSavedData as useCallback to prevent unnecessary re-renders, (3) Added auto-save functionality with 1.5s debounce using useEffect that triggers when lordoNum > 0, (4) Split handleSalva into handleSalva (auto, silent) and handleSalvaManuale (manual with sound feedback). The fix ensures data is always reloaded from AsyncStorage when returning to the Home tab, and auto-saves changes after 1.5 seconds of inactivity. Verification: All 5 test scenarios passed - basic persistence (lordo=250), manual save (lordo=500, contanti=300), auto-save (lordo=800), tab navigation (all 5 tabs), and dashboard visibility (all 8 cards visible).
